title: Written Bed-Hold Notices at Admission and at Transfer
content:
**Social services guidance — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations.**

The written bed-hold policy is given at admission, and a written bed-hold notice stating how long the bed is held, who pays and at what rate, and the return rights is given to the resident and the representative at the time of transfer. For an emergency transfer, the notice reaches the resident or representative within the emergency transfer notice hours after the departure time. No day held before the transfer notice was delivered is ever charged to the resident. A notice of each type is recorded once per delivery time.

### The two notices

| Notice | When | Contents | To whom |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bed-hold policy | at admission | the center's written bed-hold policy | the resident |
| Transfer notice | at the time of transfer; for an emergency transfer, within the emergency transfer notice hours after the departure time | how long the bed is held, who pays and at what rate, the return rights | the resident and the representative |

### Effect of the delivery time

The delivery of the transfer notice divides the held days of a leave: a day held before the notice was delivered is never the resident's charge. Each delivery of a notice is recorded once for its notice type and delivery time; a second delivery at a different time is a separate record.

**Hypothetical.** A planned transfer leaves at 10:00 and the transfer notice is handed to the resident at 09:40 and to the representative by courier the following afternoon; both deliveries are recorded, each once, under their own delivery times.
